verdict.rationale: A pricing page (getunleash.io/pricing) exists, but the cited excerpts list only plan features such as SSO, RBAC, audit logs, and export/import. No evidence shows actual prices or what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, or requests), so a product manager could not understand cost from this evidence.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing
